SELECT P.PERMISSION_CODE , P.PERMISSION_NAME , P.SORT_ORDER , P.DATA_STATUS , P.CREATED_BY , P.CREATED_AT , P.UPDATED_BY , P.UPDATED_AT FROM TB_PERMISSION P WHERE TRUE
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_ROLE_PERMISSION RP WHERE RP.PERMISSION_CODE = P.PERMISSION_CODE AND RP.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} )
AND P.DATA_STATUS = #{dataStatus}
ORDER BY P.SORT_ORDER

SELECT P.PERMISSION_CODE , P.PERMISSION_NAME , P.SORT_ORDER , P.DATA_STATUS , P.CREATED_BY , P.CREATED_AT , P.UPDATED_BY , P.UPDATED_AT FROM TB_PERMISSION P WHERE TRUE
AND P.PERMISSION_CODE = #{permissionCode}
